title: Inauguration of the Hunsur Rural Learning & Health Center
description: Blessing and opening of the newly expanded classroom building and free health checkup clinic for surrounding tribal and agrarian village families.

title: 50th Golden Jubilee of Foundation (1976 – 2026)
description: Solemn Eucharistic Thanksgiving Celebration and jubilee assembly commemorating fifty golden years of selfless family catechesis, rural home visits, and educational service in India, Germany, and Poland.

title: Feast of the Holy Family & Annual Diocesan Family Gathering
location: St. Philomena's Cathedral Grounds & SCS Family Centre, Mysore
description: Special Holy Mass and blessing of families, honoring grandparents and catechists. Interactive seminar on Christian family values and harmony in contemporary society.

title: National Workshop for Catechists & Parish Animators
description: A three-day intensive formation workshop on innovative rural catechesis, sacramental preparation for remote hamlets, and family pastoral accompaniment.

title: Vocations 'Come & See' Discernment Camp
description: An open weekend of prayer, discernment, community life, and spiritual accompaniment for young Catholic women seeking God's will and religious vocation.

title: Feast of St. Joseph the Worker & Blessing of Mission Stations
description: Patronal feast of working apostolates with special prayers for daily wage laborers, migrant families, and women's self-help tailoring cooperative units.

title: Solemnity of the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus
description: Congregation-wide Renewal of Vows and adoration vigil, entrusting all mission communities, benefactors, and foster children to the Sacred Heart of Jesus.
